verdict.rationale: BigQuery Sandbox explicitly lets analysts explore BigQuery capabilities and run real queries without providing a credit card or creating a billing account, and on-demand pricing includes 1 TiB of free query processing per month — directly matching the story of a no-card, no-sales-call evaluation path. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming the sandbox experience in practice (only first-party docs are cited, and community evidence focuses on billing surprises for paid usage rather than the sandbox itself).
